$comment: Named plugin subsets for the installers. Every marketplace plugin belongs to exactly one profile (scripts/validate.py checks this). install-copilot.sh/.ps1 default to copilotDefault; install.sh/.ps1 (Claude Code) default to claudeDefault (every plugin with --all / -All): Claude Code's skill listing has a budget, and with every plugin most skill descriptions get cut to their name. claude-only plugins rely on Claude Code features (Workflow engine, !`cmd` injection, Claude-only hook events) and are skipped by install-copilot unless named explicitly.
